// diagnostic E2123

Jet.PerfDirectoryNotPrivate

jet won't profile through `{home}`: {cause}

What

jet won't profile through `{home}`: {cause}

Why

A flight-recorded program publishes its ring in that directory and takes attach requests from it, so whoever else can reach it could read the program's profile or turn its zones on.

Fix

Remove `{home}`, or set `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` to a directory only you can open; then start the program again with `jet run --observe` and attach.
